name: Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark Dataset
description: In this study TensorFlow’s Object Detection API used in Turkey traffic sign detection and recognition of the aid intended traffic signs. A dataset suitable for TensorFlow’s Object Detection API has been prepared for traffic signs by using photographs in different traffic and weather conditions. A web-based data tagging application has been developed to prepare this dataset. This dataset was trained by selecting the appropriate deep learning model and results were obtained on the test data. Although the training data are insufficient, the results on the test images are satisfactory.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) for detection; accuracy for sign recognition
general_score_metric: mAP (mean Average Precision) for detection tasks
typical_sota_score: 80–98% (mAP/accuracy depending on dataset split and evaluation protocol)
reputation: A domain-specific dataset used in research and tutorial/demo work with TensorFlow Object Detection API; moderately used in the traffic-sign detection community but not a broadly standardized benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM computer-vision benchmark; performance depends strongly on dataset variants (sign types, illumination, occlusion); annotation inconsistencies and moderate dataset size can limit generalization; evaluation protocols (IoU thresholds, class balancing) affect comparability.
